overview: The subcommittee met to review policies concerning the school calendar, public participation, and meeting agenda formats. The committee approved recommending amendments to all three policies for consideration by the full School Committee.

items.title: School Year Calendar Policy IC/ICA Review
items.summary: The committee approved amending the policy to add Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, and Lunar New Year as no-school observances starting in the 2022-2023 school year, along with language requiring the superintendent to consult the committee if state-mandated minimum school days cannot be met.

items.title: Public Participation Policy BEDH
items.summary: The committee approved a revised public participation policy establishing clearer distinctions between scheduled presentations from the public and item-specific public comments, while refining a welcoming statement to be read by the chair.

items.title: Agenda Creation and Format Policy BEDB
items.summary: The committee voted to recommend a restructured meeting agenda that places committee reports and superintendent reports earlier while scheduling scheduled presentations and deliberative new business to begin no earlier than 7:00 p.m., with public comment taken on individual business items prior to committee debate.
